author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I just explain to my intern his task.

level 1 - the intern ran the commands to do X manually
level 2 - the intern writes a shell script to do X
level 3 - the intern uses AI coding agent to vibe code a shell script to do X
level 4 - the intern builds a reusable skill, so that the AI coding agent can generate a shell script to do X on the fly
level 5 - the intern builds a pipeline that can evaluate a reusable skill, which let the AI coding agent generate a shell script to do X on the fly

We are working on level 5.
